display_long_description:
O2 The Forest is a FREE co-op VR survival horror game for Meta Quest. By day, gather resources and explore the unknown with your team. When night falls, hold the campfire against what hunts you in the dark.

**Weekly updates bring new threats, new regions, and new classes.**

# How to survive this forest:
🪓 **Choose Your Class & Play Your Role**

Pick from classes with their own distinct roles and abilities. The team you build will define how — and whether — you survive the night.
[media]

**🌲 Co-op Survival & The Terror of Night**

Take down the infected wandering the woods with your team and claim what they leave behind. Before the dark closes in, the campfire must hold — or none of you see the next dawn.

[media]


**🔦 Exploration & Resource Gathering**

Push deeper into the deep woods, the ruins, and the unknown. Every step forward uncovers the resources that will make you stronger.

[media]

**🍖 Growth & Camp Expansion**

Cook food from what you've gathered and grow your campfire from a flicker into a stronghold. A warm meal and a bigger flame are what carry your team through the next night.

[media]

**🏠 Home Building & Protecting Your Team**

Build and decorate your own home — make it a place your teammates can truly rest. The wall you raise today may be the last shield standing when the deepest night comes.

[media]
👉 Join our official Discord to be the first to hear about updates and find the teammates who'll make it through with you.
# Discord : https://discord.gg/EYPxdcqZZT
